question: Do a full SEO audit of https://www.abacusdesk.com/: reachability, meta tags, broken links and mobile speed. Then submit a prioritised report.

report.summary: The homepage is reachable over HTTPS (200, no redirects) and its core tags are in place: title, description, canonical, a single H1, viewport and indexable robots. The biggest problem is mobile speed. The performance score is 29, LCP is 21.8 s and the page weighs about 5 MB. Smaller issues are a missing og:image, a broken email link and a broken external link.

findings.issue: Mobile LCP is 21.8 s and the performance score is only 29. The LCP element is the hero text block, and Lighthouse flags LCP request discovery and LCP breakdown problems.

evidence.value:
Business Software
Automation for every business need

Make your business more p…

findings.fix: Find the hero image or background that the LCP element depends on. Preload it with <link rel="preload" as="image"> and serve it as a compressed, correctly sized WebP or AVIF. Remove any lazy-loading and render-blocking CSS or JS on it.

findings.issue: The page is very heavy at about 5 MB. Lighthouse estimates 1,670 KiB of savings from better image delivery and 3,406 KiB from better cache lifetimes.

evidence.value: Improve image delivery: Est savings of 1,670 KiB
Use efficient cache lifetimes: Est savings of 3,406 KiB

findings.fix: Convert the large images to WebP or AVIF at their displayed dimensions. Set a Cache-Control max-age of at least 1 year on static assets (images, CSS, JS, fonts).

findings.issue: Total blocking time is high at 810 ms. The reCAPTCHA script (347 KB) is one of the heaviest resources and is requested more than once.
findings.fix: Load reCAPTCHA only when a visitor interacts with a form, or after the load event. Make sure it is initialised once rather than per form.

findings.issue: The page has layout shift (CLS 0.218, above the 0.1 'good' threshold), and font loading adds delay (about 1,290 ms of estimated savings from font-display).

evidence.value: Font display: Est savings of 1,290 ms

findings.fix: Add font-display: swap to the @font-face rules. Add explicit width and height attributes to images and banner or slider containers so their space is reserved.

findings.issue: There is no og:image, so links shared on social platforms show no preview image.

evidence.value: Missing og:title or og:image (poor social sharing previews)

findings.fix: Add <meta property="og:image" content="https://www.abacusdesk.com/..."> pointing to a 1200x630 branded image.

findings.issue: The Cloudflare email-protection link returns 404, so the obfuscated email link in the page is broken for crawlers and for users without JavaScript.
findings.fix: Replace the Cloudflare-obfuscated email link with a plain mailto: link, or turn off Email Address Obfuscation in Cloudflare. Check that the link works in a browser first.

findings.issue: The external link to manavrachna.edu.in fails with TooManyRedirects.
findings.fix: Open the link in a browser. Update the href to the final working URL, or remove the link if the site is no longer valid.

findings.issue: Several links point to URLs that redirect, including one internal link (/enterprise/google-workspace-2/).
findings.fix: Change the internal href from /enterprise/google-workspace-2/ to /enterprise/google-workspace/. Update the netkarma.ca and deltaelectronicsindia.com links to their final URLs.

findings.issue: The title is exactly 60 characters, at the edge of truncation in search results. The og:title and og:description differ from the standard title and description, and the og:description claims 'leading digital marketing company in India', which the standard tags do not.

evidence.value: World-Class Software Development, CX & Performance Marketing
Business Software & Digital Marketing Agency - Abacus Desk

findings.fix: Shorten the title to something like 'Abacus Desk: Software Development & Digital Marketing' (53 characters). Align the og:title and og:description with it.

not_checked: 14 of 64 links were skipped by the link checker (it checks a maximum of 50)
Real-user Core Web Vitals (Google returned no field data)
